654-5531-5694-7487-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-5531-5694-7487-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Zealous Lorecaster and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Zealous Lorecaster and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-5531-5694-7487-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Zealous Lorecaster and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1170-5131-5226-6289--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5226-6289--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

277-1409-7894.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
277-1409-7894.description:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Gandalf by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Gandalf enters, its first ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Gandalf.
Resolve the Gandalf trigger, blinking the lands tapped for mana in step 1.
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine and Gandalf's second ability each trigger three times.
Resolve all Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the lands that entered.
Resolve all Gandalf triggers, causing you to draw three cards and put three +1/+1 counters on Gandalf.
Repeat.

654-1479-5700-5701-7705.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-5700-5701-7705.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Mole Man trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Mole Man and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2525-3763-5147-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2525-3763-5147-6749.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Body Double from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. Choose to have Body Double enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Body Double enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Body Double from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-3518-7297.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

803-3951-5703-7122.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

803-2292-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
803-2292-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

339-677-2921-7060.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

294-2034-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Iron League Steed.
When Iron League Steed dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Iron League Steed enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3705-4050-6112-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

2034-3234-3293-5226.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2034-3234-3293-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
2034-3234-3293-5226.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

339-677-2079-2921.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Temur Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1850-5226-6701.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-5226-6701.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

4968-6824.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Deathbringer Thoctar lifelink.
4968-6824.description:
Give Deathbringer Thoctar lifelink.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

225-907-5449-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
225-907-5449-5702.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-907-5449-5702.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1168-1651-2573-5334-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-2573-5334-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-2573-5334-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

3755-4222-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

933-5261-6587-6588.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

152-1308-6252.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
152-1308-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

647-2457-2557-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-1251-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-1251-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

798-1741-2726-6022.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
Either Quickling or Faerie Impostor must be in your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
798-1741-2726-6022.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Cloud of Faeries.
Resolve the copy of the Cloud of Faeries spell, creating a token copy of it.
When the Cloud of Faeries token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the original Cloud of Faeries spell.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Cast either Quickling or Faerie Impostor from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Quickling or Faerie Impostor spell.
Resolve the copy of the Quickling or Faerie Impostor spell, creating a token copy of it.
When the Quickling or Faerie Impostor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Quickling or Faerie Impostor from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the original Quickling or Faerie Impostor spell.
When Quickling or Faerie Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4374-4636-5663.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

116-2569-4661.notablePrerequisites:
Vesuvan Doppelganger is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Vesuvan Doppelganger do not have summoning sickness.
116-2569-4661.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Vesuvan Doppelganger.
Activate Vesuvan Doppelganger by tapping it.
When Vesuvan Doppelganger becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Vesuvan Doppelganger's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1365-1537-4751-5231.notablePrerequisites: Zealous Conscripts and Verduous Gearhulk do not have a -1/-1 counter on them.
1365-1537-4751-5231.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Verdurous Gearhulk and Zealous Conscripts persist until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, adding {R}.
When Zealous Conscripts dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Verdurous Gearhulk, adding {R}.
When Verdurous Gearhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Zealous Conscripts, and two +1/+1 counters on any other creature(s) you control.
Repeat.

1643-2073-3459-5147.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Activate Clown Car's crew ability by tapping Battered Golem, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1636-3358.notablePrerequisites:
Hell's Caretaker does not have summoning sickness.
It is your upkeep step.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard and at least one additional nontoken creature on the battlefield.
1636-3358.description:
Tap Hell's Caretaker and sacrifice another creature to returning a creature in your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

721-2724-3335.notablePrerequisites: Lady Sun does not have summoning sickness.
721-2724-3335.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping them, returning Lady Sun and Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
